description.narrative:
Stakeholders Effect - Increased access to climate finance and social finance: IFC expects this project to provide long-term financing for climate finance projects (such as energy efficiency, waste management, sustainable water, clean transportation, renewable energy, etc.) and a wide range of social projects (such as women-led SMEs, healthcare, education and vocational training, etc.).
Market Creation Sustainability: IFC anticipates by helping JC Leasing improve/build a benchmark Sustainability Financing Framework/ESMS, it can set market standards to promote sustainability finance in China and to nurture interest and participation from commercial investors and development financial institutions that will facilitate the buildup of an adequate investor base for the project. The project would be IFCs first sustainability loan to a financial institution in China and one of the first of its kind in China to be LMA compliant among leasing companies. It would establish a benchmark for financial institutions in China and also for other leasing companies in China to emulate.

The proposed investment entails up to 5-year senior syndicated sustainability loan to JC International Finance & Leasing Co., Ltd. (JC Leasing or the Company), a commercial leasing company sponsored by Legend Holdings Corporation (3396.HK) in China. The loan is to support JC Leasing in growing its climate finance portfolio (energy efficiency, waste management, sustainable water, clean transportation, renewable energy, etc.) and social finance portfolio (women-led SMEs, healthcare, education and vocational training, etc.). The investment comprises (i) IFC A loan of up to US$100 million equivalent in RMB, and (ii) IFC syndicated loan of up to US$125 million equivalent in RMB. The loan will be aligned with the Green Loan Principles (GLP) and Social Loan Principles (SLP) of the Loan Market Association (LMA) to ensure transparency in use of proceeds, monitoring, and reporting. The investment is expected to be IFCs first sustainability loan to a financial institution in China.
